name: – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on narco-trafficking in Europe’s waters: protecting our borders and supporting our law enforcement officers
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking for more action against drug smuggling at sea. It wants more money and resources for police, border guards and sea patrols, and better sharing of information between countries. It wants cooperation with countries in West Africa and Latin America, where drugs pass through. It also wants ports made safer, protection for port and fishing workers who face threats, and help for victims. It says police work must respect fundamental rights, and that prevention and treatment matter too. This is a request, not a new law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission and EU agencies to act.
- **Who it affects:** Police, border and sea patrols, ports, fishing workers, and EU agencies.
- **What happens next:** The Commission and Member States decide whether to act on these requests.
